name: Crystal in the Mountains
summary: The Pendant of Myzrael pulses in your hand and a pleading reaches you, as if someone desperately needs help. A vision shows a gleaming crystal rising out of the ground in the northern mountains of Arathi, and you feel drawn to that place.

sections.title: A Silent Plea
sections.body: The pendant pulses as you hold it. From it comes a sense of pleading, as if someone is trying to reach you and badly needs your help. Then a vision opens before you: the mountains in the north of Arathi, and a gleaming crystal thrusting up out of the ground. You feel drawn to that place.

sections.title: At the Crystal
sections.body: When you find the crystal, it pulses, as if a living force were trapped within it.

aliases: how to get crystal in the mountains
where does pendant of myzrael come from
faq.answer: It begins with the Pendant of Myzrael. When you hold it, it pulses and you feel a pleading from someone who desperately needs your help.
It leads to a gleaming crystal standing in the northern mountains of Arathi, and you feel drawn to that place.
